### Added

- A checkout with no `.monkeys` of its own now reads the one on the default
  branch: `origin/HEAD`, then `main`, then `master`. A worktree on a branch cut
  before the file was committed used to find no project at all, so it ran
  with no default profile, and `remember` stored the secret under a bare
  profile that nothing in the project reads. That file is only read; a command
  that would change it refuses and names the branch that holds it.

### Fixed

- `rename` moved the keys in the vault before it rewrote `.monkeys`, and
  `remember` stored the secret before it listed the key. When the file could
  not be written, the vault was left half changed. Both now check the file
  first and change nothing when it cannot be written.

### Documentation

- [Where it is looked
  for](https://docs.monk3ys.dev/docs/concepts/dot-monkeys/#where-it-is-looked-for):
  says which file a checkout without one reads, and that it is only read.
